summary: Address6#getScope reads the multicast scope nibble for unicast addresses; getType misses ULA/6to4/documentation/NAT64; isMulticast misses named groups.
test_command: npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && { ( npx mocha ) 2>&1 | tee node_modules/.bench-out.txt; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then if grep -qE "TSError|error TS[0-9]+|Cannot find module|ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND|SyntaxError:" node_modules/.bench-out.txt; then echo "[setup failed] a test file failed to load"; elif grep -qE "AssertionError|[0-9]+ failing|^# fail [1-9]|ℹ fail [1-9]" node_modules/.bench-out.txt; then echo "--- FAIL: assertion failures"; fi; elif { [ -e test/bench_scope_type_test.ts ]; } && ! grep -q "bench:" node_modules/.bench-out.txt; then echo "[setup failed] hidden tests did not run"; rc=1; fi; exit $rc; }

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream fix; the fix is never reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.dependency_cache: test_command runs `npm ci` against the committed package-lock.json on every invocation. The time budget (< 2 minutes per run) assumes a warm npm cache (~/.npm/_cacache) holding this lockfile's packages, e.g. pre-seeded by one verifier run or a cache image; the first cold run downloads from the npm registry. Agents need no network for tests once the cache is warm.
provenance.test_runner: mocha 11 with tsx (no type-check) via the repository's .mocharc.yml (spec: test/**/*.ts), i.e. the whole suite, about 10 s. Failure classification greps the captured mocha output. Hidden-test guard: when the hidden test files are present, a run that exits 0 must show that they ran (jest/vitest: the JSON report has a bench_/bench- test file with at least one passed and no failed assertion; mocha/node:test: the captured output contains a `bench:` suite title); otherwise the command prints `[setup failed] hidden tests did not run` and exits 1.

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
